risks.risk: Automation bias - reviewers rubber-stamp agent output when overloaded
risks.mitigation: Fatigue model lowers catch rate above 85% utilisation; capacity plan keeps reviewers below it; track missed errors per reviewer

risks.risk: Over-trusting autonomous agents (L3/L4 work ships without review)
risks.mitigation: Autonomy promotions gated on evidence for exactly the work they unlock; audit sampling of act-with-audit work

risks.risk: Audit gaps when reviewer capacity runs out
risks.mitigation: Skipped audit samples are logged as audit_skipped events and reported by the AI PM

risks.risk: Simulation-to-reality gap - synthetic proficiency and difficulty may not match live agents
risks.mitigation: M6 live adapter with replayable fixtures; recalibrate proficiencies from observed outcomes

risks.risk: Model cost drift (price or token-usage changes per tier)
risks.mitigation: Cost per task tracked per tier; B13 drift monitor; downgrade-tier reviews

risks.risk: Agent confidence is miscalibrated, so escalation fires too late or too often
risks.mitigation: B12 calibration study; escalation threshold is policy config, not code

risks.risk: Accountability blur - more than one owner per task type
risks.mitigation: RACI generator enforces exactly one Accountable per task type (tested)
